title: Padang, West Sumatra — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

Overview

Padang is a city in West Sumatra with a population of 910,000. The capital of West Sumatra, a coastal city known for its Minangkabau culture, stunning beaches, and as the gateway to the Mentawai Islands. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
